![](thumbnail.png)

Next 15th May we will be having the first online meetup with community members. The plan is simple: we will be asking attendees to address two questions:

1.  What is troubling you about AI?
2.  How could CriticAI be useful for you?

The expectation is that in so doing, we will be knowing each other as well as start shaping the community. I still need to figure out which online platform to use (Matrix/Element, Jitsi, Teams...- if you have thoughts, please share them in this discussion), so I will be updating more details here in the following days, but whether you're interested in attending and/or have suggestions, please write a comment below so I can reach out.

Also, stay tuned!
